Part I


Task 1

Instructions

In this task, you will see several flowers on a meadow. Your task is to find a hidden bee by clicking on the flowers. After finding the bee, observe its flight from one flower to another, and remember it.

Next, we ask you to redraw the bee's flight path by clicking on one flower and dragging it to another flower. This creates a connection between the two flowers, and a green or red line indicates whether the connection is correct. Only if your redrawing was correct you are led to the next trial, or if you have drawn more than 10 incorrect connections. During this task, the arrangement of the flowers on the meadow may change from time to time, but this should not impede you much.

Note that, firstly, the direction in which you see the bee flying does not matter, because for every direction in which you see a bee flying, we will also present you with the opposite direction. Similarly, it doesn't matter in which direction you draw the connection.

After the task, we will periodically give you a performance score based on your first-attempt accuracy over multiple trials.

Before starting, you can try two example trials by clicking 'Continue.'
